project.html:
Project Overview

Maxim Thermal Engineering successfully designed and manufactured a CAT 3516 gas remote radiator for an oil & gas client, delivering a reliable cooling solution engineered for demanding industrial environments.

The project required precision engineering and robust construction to support the cooling requirements of a CAT 3516 gas engine operating under continuous industrial conditions. Our team focused on delivering a high-performance remote radiator capable of maintaining efficient engine cooling while ensuring long-term operational reliability.

Scope of Work

Our engineering team was responsible for:

  • Design of the CAT 3516 gas remote radiator
  • Custom engineering based on project requirements
  • Manufacturing and fabrication
  • Quality inspection and testing
  • Surface finishing and corrosion protection
  • Delivery and installation support (if applicable)

Every stage of the project was completed following strict quality standards to ensure dependable performance in critical industrial applications.

Engineering Solution

The remote radiator was engineered to provide efficient heat dissipation for a CAT 3516 gas engine operating in demanding oil & gas conditions. By combining precision manufacturing, high-quality materials, and proven engineering practices, Maxim Thermal Engineering delivered a cooling solution designed for durability, reliability, and efficient thermal performance.

Why Remote Radiators?

Remote radiator systems are widely used where engine-mounted cooling systems are not practical or where enhanced cooling capacity is required.

Key benefits include:

  • Efficient engine cooling
  • Improved equipment reliability
  • Reduced maintenance requirements
  • Flexible installation options
  • Long service life
  • Reliable operation in demanding industrial environments
